dict.inventory.description.dungeonSeal: The worn insignia of a fallen kingdom. Akash will pay coins for it.
dict.inventory.description.weaponEnhancement: Grants +0.25 base weapon damage to every weapon style when used. Can be used up to 5 times.
dict.inventory.description.armorEnhancement: Grants +5 armor when used. Can be used up to 5 times.
dict.inventory.description.spiritEnhancement: Reduces the underlying Spirit Dash cooldown by 3% when used; 5 uses reduce it by 15% in total. Requires the ability; can be used up to 5 times.
dict.dungeon.victory: The four voices fade into a single sigh. The light behind the thrones dies, and Momo feels the scroll’s rough edge beneath his fingers once more. The kingdom fell, yet its memory would not let it vanish without a trace.
dict.menu.changelog.0946.title: The Fall of the Kingdom of Yomi
dict.menu.changelog.0946.dungeon: A scroll in the Council Hall leads to a replayable three-floor dungeon with three new bosses, saved progress and a reward chest.
dict.menu.changelog.0946.arena.title: Arena fixes
dict.menu.changelog.0946.arena.0: The next-round prompt displays correctly with remapped controls.
dict.menu.changelog.0946.arena.1: The arena background follows the camera more gently, and the captain and two-headed serpent are larger with matching hitboxes.
dict.menu.changelog.0946.arena.2: The cyclopes attack independently with more variety, and their stomps accurately mark the targeted area.
dict.menu.changelog.0946.arena.3: The champion uses faster combos, larger area attacks and cyclops summons. After exhaustion, you have five seconds to land the final hit before a more aggressive shield cycle begins.
dict.menu.changelog.0946.arena.4: The champion now leaves with a walking animation after the fight.
dict.menu.changelog.0946.summons.title: Samurai and necromancer summon fixes
dict.menu.changelog.0946.summons.0: The necromancer’s raised soldiers pursue Momo as soon as they appear. Samurai now have a more consistent, detailed appearance, while summoned warriors have an undead look.
dict.menu.changelog.0946.travelFia.title: Fia and fast travel fixes
dict.menu.changelog.0946.travelFia.0: After the arena victory, Fia can be found only in her chambers.
dict.menu.changelog.0946.travelFia.1: The furnishings in Fia’s chambers stay in place during attacks.
dict.menu.changelog.0946.travelFia.2: The unlocked dungeon entrance, arena and Fia’s chambers are available for fast travel. Internal dungeon rests can be used as fast-travel destinations only from within the dungeon.
dict.menu.changelog.0946.travelFia.3: Spirit Dash’s purple trail is now visible in the Council Hall.
dict.menu.changelog.0947.title: New hope at the refuge
dict.menu.changelog.0947.0: A special keepsake can now be placed beside the Forest Refuge’s altar, unlocking new dialogue with Sora. Akash’s phone case now costs 1,500 coins.
dict.menu.changelog.0948.title: The Fall of the Sect
dict.menu.changelog.0948.0: The temple gate beyond the elder cultist leads to a new three-floor memory dungeon with three bosses, independently saved progress and a reward chest.
dict.fia.quest.name: Talisman of the Silenced Hymn
dict.fia.quest.offer:
Kiba preserves memories, Momo. Sometimes it lets you so close that you can feel the air of the past. Have you heard how Japan’s demon-worshipping sect fell?

I want the high priestess’s talisman. Enter the memory beyond the ruined temple gate and bring it to me. Take care, little samurai — not every hymn wishes to be silenced.
dict.fia.quest.handover: Dark Kiba pulses within the talisman. Momo is reluctant to let it leave his hand, yet he offers it to Fia. She helped him find Haru’s trail; now it is his turn to keep a promise.
dict.fia.quest.thanks: See? I knew you would bring it back to me. Don’t look so serious; eat before it gets cold. Save your questions for the evening — I’ll gladly hear them if you sit beside me.
dict.fia.quest.reminder: The high priestess keeps it, deep within the temple’s memory. I’ll wait for you, Momo.
dict.fia.quest.objective.retrieve: Retrieve the high priestess’s talisman from the temple’s memory.
dict.inventory.description.priestessTalisman: Dark Kiba from the silenced hymn courses through it. Fia asked for this from the temple’s memory.
dict.inventory.description.roastChicken: Fia’s fragrant provisions. Restores up to 4 HP immediately. Use it from your inventory or with {0} when selected as your healing item; it is not consumed at full health.
dict.inventory.description.kitsuneSoul: A fox’s shadow turns within the violet flame. Kiba remembers even those we can no longer call back.
dict.fia.conflict.victory: Fia’s flame goes out. One by one, the faces of the Shadow Den turn toward Momo. He is no longer their guest.
dict.ability.kibaShield.description: Passively absorbs up to {0} damage. Recharges {1} seconds after breaking, while gameplay is active. Upgrade it at shrines. It cannot prevent a fatal fall.
dict.menu.changelog.0949.title: Fia’s new request
dict.menu.changelog.0949.0: After the arena victory, Fia offers a new quest tied to the temple’s memory, rewarding XP and roast chicken that can be assigned to quick use.
dict.dev.cache.help: Loaded images remain in memory; reload the page for a complete check.
dict.menu.changelog.0950.title: Steadier scenery and image cache
dict.menu.changelog.0950.0: Backgrounds stay aligned with the terrain during attacks in the Shadow Den and other affected locations.
dict.menu.changelog.0950.1: The game uses a local image cache for each release and automatically removes its own older caches.
dict.menu.changelog.0950shield.title: Shadow Den health bars and Kiba Shield
dict.menu.changelog.0950shield.0: Hostile Shadow Den residents now show health bars. A countdown tracks the acquired Kiba Shield’s recharge; shrine upgrades increase absorption and reduce recharge time.
dict.menu.changelog.0951.title: Full health on level-up
dict.menu.changelog.0951.0: Momo’s health is restored to his current maximum whenever he levels up.
dict.menu.changelog.0952.title: Living scenery and preserved journeys
dict.menu.changelog.0952.0: Dungeon entrances now have a distinct fast-travel icon.
dict.menu.changelog.0952.1: Locations now feature subtle background animations that pause with the game and respect reduced motion.
dict.menu.changelog.0952.2: Compatible updates preserve progress; saves reset only when a change makes them incompatible.
dict.ziggurat.name: Blended Ziggurat
dict.descent.quest: I heard the guards, Momo. There is a gate at the bottom of the ziggurat that leads to Japan. I do not know what keeps it open, but the cultists feared its guardian. Let us go down together. This time, I will not let go of your hand.
dict.descent.portalStory: This is the gate. I can feel the air of home beyond it… but something alien clings to its stone. We must deal with the guardian first.
dict.descent.arrival: Japan… yet these mountains seem to have broken free of the earth. Haru rests a hand on Momo’s shoulder. They have returned from shadow, but the road ahead is still unknown.
dict.descent.objective.haru: Speak with Haru in Hannah’s throne hall.
dict.descent.objective.descend: Reach the bottom of the ziggurat with Haru.
dict.descent.objective.portal: Step through the portal to Japan.
dict.descent.objective.arrival: Speak with Haru in the Floating Mountains.
dict.islands.name: Floating Islands
dict.islands.hook.desc: Pulls the first small regular enemy in Momo’s facing direction toward him. If there is no such target, pulls Momo toward the nearest visible fixed anchor ahead. Range: 900 world pixels. Does not affect bosses. Cooldown: 2.5 seconds.
dict.islands.enter: E · Continue to the Floating Islands
dict.islands.takeHook: E · Pick up the grappling hook
dict.help.grapple: {0}: use the grappling hook on the highlighted anchor or the first small enemy ahead.
dict.islands.abduction: Smoke swallows the ninja’s silhouette. Haru reaches for Momo, but a hook pulls him into the mist. By the time the wind clears the smoke, only a discarded grappling hook remains on the stone.
dict.islands.objective.trail: Follow Haru’s abductors across the islands.
dict.descent.locked: The gatekeeper holds the gate shut.
dict.ziggurat.hannah: Hannah, Demon Lord of the Shadow Realm
dict.ziggurat.objective.interior: Find a way up to Hannah’s throne hall.
dict.ziggurat.objective.haru: Speak with Haru atop the ziggurat.
dict.ziggurat.monologue: Did you think my strength ended at the edge of my scythe? Look around, Momo. They gave themselves to me long ago. Now I reclaim what is mine — and your father will watch you kneel.
dict.ziggurat.failure: Haru’s Kiba fades. Momo refuses to accept this silence. You can retry the fight from the beginning; Haru’s fate can still be changed.
dict.ziggurat.fiaRescue: Were you planning to take all the glory without me, little samurai? Leave the chains to me. You still owe me a return visit.
dict.ziggurat.lightningRescue: Lightning splits the pillar. Haru’s chains fall away; he finds his footing among the ruins and moves toward Momo.
dict.ziggurat.awakening: Momo… I’m here. Kiba belongs neither to me alone nor to you alone. Remember what we learned together. Let it flow through you — and give it a blade.
dict.ziggurat.continuation: For so long, I carried only your voice within me. Now you stand before me. Hannah has fallen silent, yet something still stirs beneath the ziggurat. Stay beside me a moment, Momo. Then we will face what comes next together.
dict.ability.dawnblade.description: Summons a flaming katana of light to strike ahead for eight times your base weapon damage. Cooldown: 60 active gameplay seconds. Recoil costs 10 HP but cannot reduce you below 1 HP. Usable with all three weapon styles; cannot be upgraded separately.
dict.help.dawnblade: {0}: unleash Dawnblade once Haru has awakened its power.
dict.menu.changelog.0953.title: Storm over the Ziggurat
dict.menu.changelog.0953.0: After the Mad Priest’s defeat, a new three-part ziggurat leads to Hannah and Haru’s trail. Dawnblade’s power can awaken during the story. Compatible saves are preserved.
dict.menu.changelog.0954.title: Living scenery in Japan and Yomi
dict.menu.changelog.0954.0: Painted foliage, clouds, flames, lava and smoke subtly change in Japan and Yomi. The motion pauses with the game, while reduced motion shows the original artwork.
dict.menu.changelog.0955.title: Living scenery across the realms
dict.menu.changelog.0955.0: Subtle environmental motion now brings painted backgrounds to life across the main realms, hidden arenas, camps, interiors and dungeons. Motion pauses with the game; reduced motion displays the original paintings.
dict.item.demonLordSoul: Soul of the First Demon Lord
dict.inventory.description.demonLordSoul: The shadow of Hannah’s scythe circles within this soul. Orange Kiba still glows among its black flames.
dict.inventory.description.demonLordHeart: The fallen demon lord’s heart pulses with dark Kiba. You can give it to Fia.
dict.fia.heart.give: E · Give the Demon Lord’s Heart to Fia
dict.fia.heart.thanks: A demon lord’s heart… for me? You’re beginning to spoil me, little samurai. I’ll keep this — and I wouldn’t mind seeing your smile more often, either.
dict.story.journeyEnd: You have reached the end of the journey—for now.
dict.menu.changelog.0955polish.title: Hannah and realm fixes
dict.menu.changelog.0955polish.0: Hannah’s return dash and shadow echoes now deal damage; she uses new combos and area attacks, and her arena keeps the fight contained.
dict.menu.changelog.0955polish.1: The ending scene and Dawnblade strike now visibly play out. Haru has an older appearance, and Hannah grants new soul and heart rewards.
dict.menu.changelog.0955polish.2: Backgrounds appear at a more natural scale, the upper ziggurat shrine is separately accessible, and the compass follows main-story progress.
dict.menu.changelog.0955polish.3: The cursor hides during gameplay and becomes a paw in menus. Healing numbers are formatted clearly, and Momo’s armor protection grows more gradually.
dict.menu.changelog.0956.title: Training and hidden-route fixes
dict.menu.changelog.0956.0: Health and weapon damage can be upgraded without a rank cap while training points remain. Spirit Dash stops accepting upgrades at its shortest cooldown; points spent on ranks beyond that limit are refunded.
dict.menu.changelog.0956.1: The Shadow Den requires Fia’s rescue. If you leave the prison without freeing her, only a dead fox remains in her cell.
dict.menu.changelog.0956.2: The winged serpent’s own background remains visible inside its arena. Hannah’s frames have corrected hand anatomy and scythe grips.

dict.menu.changelog.0958.0: Furnishings in the forge, forest hut and mystic tent now stay aligned with the terrain.
dict.menu.changelog.0958.1: The Demon Lord’s Heart is awarded only for the appropriate story ending.
dict.menu.changelog.0958.2: Haru’s name now appears above his head, and Fia also has a nameplate in the throne hall.
dict.menu.changelog.0958.ad2970f7.title: Duel and adventure fixes
dict.menu.changelog.0958.ad2970f7.0: Duel window buttons now have consistent dimensions; separate indicators show player connections and readiness.
dict.menu.changelog.0958.ad2970f7.1: The elder cultist’s cave wall can only be broken from its lower approach.
dict.menu.changelog.0958.ad2970f7.2: Healing quick use starts empty and automatically selects the first healing item acquired.
dict.menu.changelog.0958.ad2970f7.3: Yomi’s guardian no longer skips crossed summoning thresholds after taking heavy damage.

dict.menu.changelog.0958.ff870c2e.0: Roast meat feedback now shows the HP actually restored instead of your total current health.

dict.menu.changelog.0958.d571f283.0: Clicking the play area locks the mouse so it cannot drift outside the window. Opening menus releases the lock, and Esc also pauses the adventure.
dict.menu.changelog.0958.a8ee4aae.title: Duel, enemy behaviour and Hannah fixes
dict.menu.changelog.0958.a8ee4aae.0: Keyboard movement still works after releasing mouse lock with Esc during a duel.
dict.menu.changelog.0958.a8ee4aae.1: Regular enemies no longer become stuck idle when Momo is nearby on a higher platform.
dict.menu.changelog.0958.a8ee4aae.2: In Hannah’s second phase, shadow echoes attack only during dashes and jumping attacks, while dark Kiba surrounds her throughout.
dict.menu.changelog.0958.a8ee4aae.3: Hannah’s ground eruptions show their warnings and impacts throughout the arena.
dict.menu.changelog.0958.a8ee4aae.4: Haru’s lightning rescue is marked by a bolt descending from above.
dict.combat.title: Combat display
dict.menu.changelog.0959.6fe22d89.title: Customizable combat display
dict.menu.changelog.0959.6fe22d89.0: Enable damage numbers for Momo and enemies, and numeric boss health independently in the help panel. Developer test mode uses its own toggles. Support Momo through the Ko-fi link in the main and pause menus.
dict.menu.changelog.0959.51e0d08d.title: Hannah’s model-bound aura
dict.menu.changelog.0959.51e0d08d.0: Dark Kiba follows Hannah’s current silhouette and remains visible throughout her second phase.
dict.fia.dragon.offer:
Hannah’s ashes have barely settled, and already you would take that lovely, determined gaze away from me? Stay a moment, Momo. An ancient drake struggles against its chains beneath the ziggurat. The cultists filled it with shadow; what they could not break, they simply locked away.

Bring me its eyes. They have seen things I would like to know. Leave the rest to me, little samurai.
dict.fia.dragon.turnIn:
How beautifully they still hold the light… Let me have them. Don’t look at me like that, Momo; after so much darkness, surely we deserve something that finally obeys us.

I’m returning to the Shadow Den. There is a quieter room beyond my chambers. Find me there — next time, I would rather no one overheard us.
dict.inventory.description.dragonEyes: The last light of the tormented ancient drake’s gaze. Fia asked for these from the depths of the ziggurat.
dict.inventory.description.dragonScale: A heavy, ash-grey scale with shadow Kiba frozen in its veins. Its hardness is worthy of armor.
dict.fia.dragon.objective.1: Break the chains pinning the wings!
dict.fia.dragon.objective.2: Clear the drake’s back and reach its head!
dict.fia.dragon.objective.3: Weaken both forelegs, then attack the fallen head!
dict.fia.dragon.objective.return: Bring the drake’s eyes to Fia.
dict.menu.changelog.0960.7dff177a.title: The Gaze Beyond the Chains
dict.menu.changelog.0960.7dff177a.0: Fia’s new request leads to a three-stage ancient drake raid beneath the ziggurat. The encounter is replayable; scales drop on every victory, while the quest item requires an active request.
dict.fia.void.offer:
Come closer. The drake’s eyes revealed something the cultists hid even from themselves. Below us, in the deepest underworld, a tear has opened in the fabric of the world. I sent my guards there… now they no longer answer even my voice.

Bring me something of the power beyond it. One pure crystal will suffice. You have free passage among my people, Momo — just remember who is waiting for your return.
dict.fia.void.return:
Do you hear it? I no longer have to beg it to answer. Give it to me, Momo. The eyes showed the way; this may finally open it.

Why are you holding it so tightly? I trusted you. Now it is your turn, little samurai.
dict.fia.void.thanks: How obediently it rests in my palm… See? There was no reason to fear it. Eat, rest. I will need you again — closer than ever before.
dict.inventory.description.rawVoidCrystal: Raw matter left behind by the sealed tear. Alien Kiba circles beneath its cold surface. Fia asked for this.
dict.fia.void.sealed: The tear has closed. The void’s trace remains within you.
dict.fia.void.warning: Do not let it heal to full!
dict.fia.void.objective.explore: Investigate the tear beneath the underworld.
dict.merchant.trader.sold: You sold the item to the trader.
dict.menu.changelog.0961.01a95ac7.title: Shard of the Void
dict.menu.changelog.0961.01a95ac7.0: Fia’s next request leads into the Shadow Den’s underworld and a forbidden tear. New services, maddened guards and a quest ending in a choice await Momo.
dict.fia.ritual.offer:
Only two voices are missing now, Momo. The white attendant waits in the Shadow Den; the red one is below, in the underworld. Tell them their queen calls for them.

Come back too. After so many favors, I can finally offer you something I give no one else. Just be sure to stand close to me, little samurai.
dict.fia.ritual.white.dialogue: Fia calls? Then I will not keep her waiting. She said the bad dreams would finally fall silent tonight.
dict.fia.ritual.red.dialogue: The queen’s ritual… so the time has come. I will be there, Momo. Walk us back to the fire when we are done.
dict.fia.ritual.betrayal:
The chains close before Momo understands the ritual. The white attendant’s voice grows faint, then falls silent. The red one is still calling Fia’s name when the altar swallows her last light.

Two empty shackles sway behind Momo. Now the four relics turn their hunger toward him.
dict.fia.ritual.provoked: Don’t look at me like that. You brought me everything I needed. You could still stay beside me — if only you would give me that last little light.
dict.fia.ritual.break: Momo does not answer. Haru’s teaching awakens as a burning line in his grasp. Dawnblade’s light shatters the chains, but it is too late for the two attendants.
dict.fia.ritual.phase: Then watch what you have given me! Hymn, heart, sight, emptiness… all mine. I cannot lose you now, Momo!
dict.fia.ritual.victory:
Momo’s blade cleaves the altar’s last light. The relics crumble to dust, and Fia’s foxfire retreats into a katana.

Outside, alien Kiba spreads through the people of the Shadow Den. Faces that once welcomed a guest twist into something else. Momo cannot linger over his victory — he must get out.
dict.inventory.description.foxfireKatana: A katana holding Fia’s lingering foxfire. Its unique strikes deal 20% greater damage and ignite enemies for 3 seconds, dealing 1 base damage per second. Further hits refresh the burn duration. Normal attack: {0} damage. Heavy attack: {1} damage.
dict.menu.changelog.0962.08e4907c.title: Fia’s final request
dict.menu.changelog.0962.08e4907c.0: Fia’s questline continues with a new ritual and an obtainable foxfire weapon.
dict.menu.changelog.0963.33d7b168.title: The ancient drake’s new combat cycle
dict.menu.changelog.0963.33d7b168.0: In the ancient drake’s final phase, weakening both forelegs briefly exposes its fallen head to attacks.
dict.menu.changelog.0963.fb5ba452.title: Duel platform and main menu fixes
dict.menu.changelog.0963.fb5ba452.0: You can now drop through floating platforms in duels by pressing down and jump together.
dict.menu.changelog.0963.fb5ba452.1: The main menu support button now appears beside the other utility buttons.
dict.menu.changelog.0963.4f9a5322.title: Dragon raid and Fia quest fixes
dict.menu.changelog.0963.4f9a5322.0: The drake and supporting pillars align with the ground; pillars crack over time and collapse one by one. The flying drake’s silhouette stays intact.
dict.menu.changelog.0963.4f9a5322.1: The new Shadow Den locations show solid ground, backgrounds are less enlarged, and the gate guards stand at the underworld entrance.
dict.menu.changelog.0963.4f9a5322.2: Fia’s new quests use exclamation and question marks; a cue showing Dawnblade’s current binding helps you break free of the chains.
dict.menu.changelog.0963.4f9a5322.3: The Void Demon heals for twenty times the health it actually removes. The Foxfire Katana has unique animations and a refreshing burn effect.
dict.menu.changelog.0963.3042e400.title: Clearer travel and Fia’s final trial
dict.menu.changelog.0963.3042e400.0: Fast travel presents known destinations on a painted map, grouped by realm and area, with distinct dungeon and raid markers.
dict.menu.changelog.0963.3042e400.1: The pause menu’s support button is no longer highlighted by default.
dict.menu.changelog.0963.3042e400.2: Fia’s final ritual fight features denser attack sequences and summons the two attendants’ spirits; the ritual consumes her health more slowly.
dict.tower.name: Endless Tower
dict.tower.new.info: Starting a new run clears the tower checkpoint but keeps your record.
dict.tower.info: The tower is a challenge separate from your journey save. Start with 20 base HP, double jump and Spirit Dash. Clearing a floor restores 2 HP; every fifth cleared floor fully heals you and creates a checkpoint. Resume from there after death or leaving. Every floor grants coins and a choice of power-up. Every fifth floor contains only bosses; afterward, Akash sells healing items. Checkpoints also preserve power-ups, coins and supplies.

dict.menu.changelog.0965.176f3376.0: The main menu now has its own looping theme, controlled by the sound toggle, which stops when gameplay begins.

dict.menu.changelog.0968.9feefa17.title: Retry arena rounds
dict.menu.changelog.0968.9feefa17.0: After death in the Shadow Den Arena, restart the current round without repeating earlier rounds. One-time rewards cannot be earned again.
dict.menu.changelog.0969.1e6d43a0.title: A Way Home Below
dict.menu.changelog.0969.1e6d43a0.0: After Hannah’s defeat, Haru follows Momo into the ziggurat depths. New enemies, a void-tainted gatekeeper and a portal to Japan’s floating mountains continue the main story.
dict.help.fullscreen: Ctrl+F: toggle fullscreen mode. Esc leaves fullscreen; the adventure pauses, while a duel keeps running.
dict.menu.changelog.0970.a818a30b.title: Fullscreen and quest fixes
dict.menu.changelog.0970.a818a30b.1: A percentage bar at the bottom of the screen replaces the loading popup.
dict.menu.changelog.0970.a818a30b.2: Turning in Daichi’s rescue quest for the first time grants 600 XP. Previously completed quests do not receive a retroactive reward.
dict.menu.changelog.0970.a818a30b.3: Fia stays in place until the dragon-eye turn-in dialogue ends.
dict.menu.changelog.0970.88f2c94c.title: Haru prompt and ziggurat gate fixes
dict.menu.changelog.0970.88f2c94c.0: Haru’s interaction prompt now displays correctly.
dict.menu.changelog.0970.88f2c94c.1: The gate from the ziggurat interior to its depths now appears as a separate, visible portal; the altar remains a rest point.
dict.menu.changelog.0970.88f2c94c.2: Previous saves are incompatible with this release; start a new journey. Language and control preferences are preserved.
dict.menu.changelog.0971.e96d3917.title: Grappling Above the Clouds
dict.menu.changelog.0971.e96d3917.0: A new story route across the Floating Islands continues Momo’s journey with Siamese shadow ninjas and an obtainable grappling hook.
dict.menu.changelog.0972.ab740729.title: Bosses of the realms in the tower
dict.menu.changelog.0972.ab740729.0: The Endless Tower roster now includes tower-adapted versions of the missing main and optional bosses. Encounters run without story events; existing checkpoints, records and your journey save are preserved.
dict.menu.changelog.0972.cc8d0925.title: Ninja and grappling hook fixes
dict.menu.changelog.0972.cc8d0925.0: The ninja leader appears larger, and the Floating Islands’ backgrounds blend more smoothly. Picking up the hook shows instructions, and the route can be travelled in both directions. Pulled enemies no longer snap back to their old positions, and the hook has a 2.5-second cooldown.
dict.zen.purify.dialogue:
Momo, I can barely hear this melody beneath the darkness… but it is not lost. Let me purify it for you. While you are beside me, let me watch over your light for a little while.

If you find other corrupted sacred relics, bring them to me. I will free the Kiba trapped within them too, so it may strengthen you on your journey.
dict.zen.purify.reward: The sacred hymn has been purified. +{0} training points.
dict.menu.changelog.0973.e03f9a22.title: Zen’s purifying prayer
dict.menu.changelog.0973.e03f9a22.0: Once rescued, Zen can purify the corrupted hymn at the Forest Refuge for a one-time reward of training points.
dict.watchtower.name: Ninja Watchtower
dict.inventory.desc.watchtowerCellKey: Opens Westheru’s cell in the watchtower dungeon. Use it beside the cell with {0}.
dict.watchtower.return: E · Return to the Floating Islands
dict.watchtower.rescueStory: Oh, a friendly face! I’m Westheru. The ninjas took my balloon and locked me down here. They took the young shiba’s father onward, but perhaps we can find his trail from above. Get me to the roof, and I’ll fly us out of here.
dict.watchtower.escapeStory: The crossbow falls silent. The sentinel casts smoke across the roof and disappears into the wind. Westheru is already untying the balloon’s ropes.
dict.balloon.transformStory: Westheru clutches his vest. Blue light runs through his grey fur; a moment later, a seal stands before Momo, lightning crackling between his flippers.
dict.balloon.restoredStory: The lightning fades. Westheru sits on the stone as a shiba once more. ‘Oh dear, my vest… I hope I didn’t frighten you too badly. The balloon is still sound. Let’s keep going!’
dict.balloon.arrivalStory: The wind twists into a funnel and swallows the balloon. When Westheru lands, unfamiliar mountains float around them. Ninjas and cultists move among the rocks. Haru’s trail leads onward.
dict.watchtower.objective.escort: Escort Westheru to the watchtower roof.
dict.balloon.objective.wasps: Defeat the wasps so the balloon can move on.
dict.balloon.objective.dragon: Defeat the dragon before it destroys the balloon!
dict.balloon.failed: The balloon was destroyed. You can retry this stage.
dict.menu.changelog.0974.95d17dc4.title: From Watchtower to the Clouds
dict.menu.changelog.0974.95d17dc4.0: A new companion awaits rescue in the watchtower dungeon. Westheru’s balloon voyage leads through wasp swarms, a battle with a sky dragon and a strange storm to the far side of a vortex.
dict.balloon.departureStory: So many cultists… You know what, Momo? I’d rather keep an eye on things from above. I’ll drop you off here, then carry on in the balloon. Take care!
dict.menu.changelog.0974.e86e9e6e.title: Watchtower, balloon voyage and boss effect fixes
dict.menu.changelog.0974.e86e9e6e.0: The watchtower’s entrance shrine has moved to a separate spot, and numeric boss health is visible. Background scale remains stable when jumping, with smoother transitions. Cultists in the new area are stronger; Westheru arrives beyond the vortex in the balloon, then flies onward. Tower and story bosses use shared configuration and consistent spell artwork.
dict.menu.changelog.0974.92487480.title: Painted cell and internal fixes
dict.menu.changelog.0974.92487480.0: Westheru’s cell now uses the game’s painted cage artwork. The cell key’s description and use have been corrected.
dict.menu.changelog.0974.cbf2c125.title: Consistent tower boss health bars
dict.menu.changelog.0974.cbf2c125.0: Endless Tower bosses now display a single health bar, while numeric HP continues to follow your display setting.
dict.menu.changelog.0974.e6a13739.title: Serpent projectile and Storm Island fixes
dict.menu.changelog.0974.e6a13739.0: The White Serpent’s frost shards render more efficiently. Fia’s conversation prompt displays correctly. The Storm Island shrine is separated from the gate, and the final area’s background stays steady during jumps without repeated artwork.
dict.saves.title: Saves
dict.saves.invalid: This save is invalid or incompatible with this release.
dict.saves.failed: The save operation failed. Check your browser storage.
dict.saves.newConfirm: Start a new journey in the active save slot? Its existing progress will be overwritten.
dict.saves.info: Store three separate journeys. Import an exported file in another browser. The file contains journey progress; tower records, language and controls remain separate.
dict.menu.changelog.0975.d3747dd1.title: Journey saves and character catalog
dict.menu.changelog.0975.d3747dd1.0: Three save slots and portable journey export/import help you continue across browsers. Your existing journey moves into the first slot.
dict.menu.changelog.0976.43eb6582.title: Westheru’s storm
dict.menu.changelog.0976.43eb6582.0: In seal form, Westheru summons a windstorm and a meteor shower in the story and the Endless Tower.
dict.ninjaClan.name: The Fractured Clan
dict.skyDragonRaid.name: The Sky Dragon
dict.skyDragonRaid.harborGoal: Hit the dragon before it destroys all three ballistas!
dict.skyDragonRaid.backGoal: Defeat the cultists and the Rift Warden!
dict.skyDragonRaid.riftGoal: Grapple within reach of the dragon and defeat it before the rift opens!
dict.inventory.description.cloudDragonScale: Daigo can forge armor from three of these scales and three Ancient Drake Scales.
dict.inventory.description.cloudNinjaRing: Bears the mark of the Cloud Ninja clan. Show it to Reika.
dict.storyRaid.ring.description: Bears the mark of the Cloud Ninja clan. Show it to Westheru.
dict.storyRaid.ring.westheru: Reika knew this mark. The Cloud Ninjas guided lost travellers home between the islands. I’ll keep the ring. Next time you set out, I’ll show you the routes she taught me.
dict.inventory.description.cloudscaleArmor: Reduces incoming spell damage by 20% while equipped.
dict.skyDragonRaid.forgeCost: Requires 3 Cloud Dragon Scales and 3 Ancient Drake Scales.
dict.skyDragonRaid.reika: The Cloud Ninjas once wore this mark. They travelled between the islands, and at every port someone would guide the lost home. The clan vanished, but some of their routes remain. Come see me before you leave again. I’ll show you the ones I still know.
dict.storyRaid.name: The Second Ziggurat
dict.item.thirdClanLeaderSoul: Soul of the Third Clan Leader
dict.item.cultWarMarshalSoul: Soul of the Cultist War Marshal
dict.item.secondDemonLordSoul: Soul of the Second Demon Lord
dict.inventory.description.thirdClanLeaderSou: The clan’s last hand seal echoes within.
dict.inventory.description.cultWarMarshalSoul: It still holds the sounds of the ziggurat’s siege.
dict.inventory.description.secondDemonLordSou: For a moment, the Kiba within takes on an unfamiliar shape.
dict.storyRaid.objective.enter: Follow Haru’s trail deeper into the cave.
dict.storyRaid.objective.mark: Reika has marked the real Signal Keeper.
dict.storyRaid.intro: Deep in the cave, the tracks split. Reika points to the marks cut into the stone. ‘The clan’s path leads to the ziggurat. If you see doubles, wait for my signal.’ Westheru follows them from outside in his airship.
dict.storyRaid.rescue: Reika braces the collapsing gate. ‘Momo, now!’ Haru breaks free and crosses the threshold. Reika smiles one last time. The stone falls, and her voice can no longer be heard from the other side.
dict.storyRaid.haru: Your blade no longer turns against you, Momo. Let Kiba flow through you as we practised together. I see light beyond the gate. Let’s go.
dict.storyRaid.dawnblade.description: Summons a flaming katana of light to strike ahead for eight times your base weapon damage. Cooldown: 60 active gameplay seconds. It no longer costs health to use. Usable with all three weapon styles.
dict.thirdClan.reika: The third clan swore loyalty to the cultists. They fight only with ninjutsu, and we must search their paths for Haru. Three ballistas guard the skies below their camp. Disable them and Westheru can fly after you. At the end of the path, a cave opens in the cliff. Look for his trail there.
dict.thirdClan.westheru: The skies are clear! Keep away from the demon, Momo. The ninjas fitted my ballista for this voyage.
dict.thirdClan.trail.story: A scrap of Haru’s clothing is caught on the cave wall. Two sets of footprints lead deeper into the dust. Momo has a trail to follow now.
dict.thirdClan.enter: E · Enter the third clan’s path
dict.thirdClan.return.camp: E · Return to the ninja camp
dict.thirdClan.return.path: E · Return to the clan’s path
dict.thirdClan.objective.reika: Speak with Reika in the ninja camp.
dict.thirdClan.objective.armor: Break the demon’s armor with heavy attacks!
dict.thirdClan.objective.trail: Inspect Haru’s trail by the cave.
dict.ninjaClan.transform: Your loyalty is worth little. Your body can still serve.
dict.ninjaClan.surrender: Enough. I saw what they did to our leader. They’re already preparing the next ritual in the sanctum. I’ll let you through. And don’t look so pleased with yourself, Momo.
dict.ninjaClan.reikaCamp: Thank you, Momo. Some of the cultists escaped. The infected still roam the trails, and the third clan still sees us as enemies. Stay until you’ve caught your breath. It’s easier for me to keep an eye on you here.
dict.ninjaClan.zenSeal: This seal still remembers who belonged to the clan. Stay by my side, Momo. Together we’ll quiet what has taken hold of it.
dict.inventory.description.ninjaClanLeaderSou: A trace of the leader’s Kiba from before the infection still glimmers within.
dict.inventory.description.ninjaCorruptedSeal: The clan’s jade seal. Zen can purify the Kiba trapped within.
dict.inventory.description.ninjaCampSpoils: Valuables recovered from the camp. Akash will pay coins for them.
dict.menu.changelog.0981.f227c9a4.title: The Second Ziggurat
dict.menu.changelog.0981.f227c9a4.0: Haru’s trail leads to a three-stage story raid with nine bosses and checkpoints between encounters. Reika and Westheru take part in the battles.
dict.menu.changelog.0980.07ba03f6.title: Path of the Third Clan
dict.menu.changelog.0980.07ba03f6.0: Reika sends Momo after Haru’s trail. Disable three ballistas on the descending path and break the cave guardian’s armor before Westheru arrives.
dict.menu.changelog.0979.4e6279ea.title: The Sky Dragon
dict.menu.changelog.0979.4e6279ea.0: A replayable four-phase raid starts at the ninja camp’s skyport, with a checkpoint at each phase. Daigo can forge spell-resistant armor from the scales you collect.
dict.menu.changelog.0978.16d08d67.title: The Fractured Clan
dict.menu.changelog.0977.04dda57a.title: Level up to 50
dict.menu.changelog.0978.16d08d67.0: A new three-floor dungeon leads from Beyond the Vortex to the ninja camp. A healer and a smith help Momo there, with weapon and armor upgrades available up to rank 10.
dict.menu.changelog.0977.04dda57a.0: Momo’s maximum level is now 50. XP previously earned after reaching level 30 counts toward further progression.
dict.menu.changelog.0982.97647ded.title: Maps from a JSON catalog
dict.menu.changelog.0982.97647ded.0: Map data for the main realms, camps, interiors, dungeons, raids, duel arenas and the tower is now maintained in shared JSON catalogs. The build validates these catalogs, and the game assembles its maps from them.
